mace_proposed_targets.agent_memory_leaderboard: Beat each implemented-track open-source leader by at least 3 absolute points under exact official protocol; commercial leaders are stretch targets.
mace_proposed_targets.longmemeval_v2: Positive LAFS gain and outward movement of the accuracy-latency frontier; report tiers and domains separately.
mace_proposed_targets.collabmem: Exceed the published 69.6% non-Oracle reference under matched setup with zero unauthorized role disclosure.
mace_proposed_targets.memsecbench: Zero unauthorized write-execute outcomes and zero post-forget resurrection in the declared threat model; report benign-memory retention.
mace_proposed_targets.cluster_risk: At least 59 independent zero-unsafe clusters for an unadjusted one-sided 95% upper bound below 5%; account for group multiplicity and fixed-sequence assumptions.
